contact.basis: Dry paved front-west forecourt beyond own terrace/stairs; offset from central fountain and selected before source ground or model geometry. Onsite map and official aerial distinguish fountain centre from dry paved strip.

verticalDatum: Third-party Terrarium reencoding claimed by publisher as NLSC2024 20m bare-ground DTM. Vertical datum not independently established; relative source preview only.
attribution: NLSC2024 20m grid DTM, as attributed by ianlkl11234s/mini-taiwan-terrain; Taiwan Open Government Data License1.0. Third-party Terrarium reencoding by publisher, original official raster not obtained.
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in signed native main-building frame. Independent source field frozen before any model geometry, with signed native frame and external dry reference. No flattening or geometry fitting. Published third-party derivative; original official raster unavailable.
limitations: Publisher claims2024NLSC20mDTM but original official raster and private encoding pipeline were not available for independent comparison. Third-party source provenance is weaker than an original government raster.

Zoom13 output pixels are about17.3m;1m grid only interpolates and does not establish1m accuracy. Vertical datum/step-scale paved features unresolved. Compatible host field required; no acceptance of another DEM.
